categories.main_business_segments: The company primarily operates in the semiconductor materials industry, focusing on electronic chemicals for semiconductor manufacturing and packaging. Its main product segments include electroplating solutions and related reagents, photoresists and related reagents, and electroplating auxiliary materials. It serves key processes in semiconductor packaging, advanced packaging, wafer manufacturing, and semiconductor display.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company leverages proprietary compound formulation technologies, electrochemical preparation methods, and application technologies for electronic chemicals. It has developed advanced electroplating additives for copper and tin-silver plating, high-performance photoresists including negative and positive PSPI, chemical amplification photoresists, and OLED photoresists. Production methods include batch production with strict quality control, and turnkey solutions integrating chemical products with process optimization and technical support.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Key customers are leading domestic semiconductor packaging and testing companies, wafer manufacturers, and display panel producers. The company serves the semiconductor industry chain including integrated circuits, semiconductor displays, and new electronic components. Major clients include Changdian Technology, Tongfu Microelectronics, Huatian Technology, Shanghai Huali, Silan Microelectronics, and BOE Technology Group.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates mainly in China, with domestic sales accounting for over 93% of revenue. It has expanded overseas through acquisition of Malaysian company INOFINE CHEMICALS SDN BHD, which is now a controlled subsidiary, marking a step towards Southeast Asia and global markets. It also has subsidiaries in Singapore and Malaysia.
categories.supply_chain_position: The company operates upstream in the semiconductor supply chain as a supplier of key electronic chemical materials used in semiconductor wafer fabrication, packaging, and display manufacturing. It provides critical materials that support downstream semiconductor device manufacturers and packaging service providers.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: Strategically, the company focuses on deepening technology in semiconductor electroplating and photoresist materials, especially targeting advanced packaging and wafer manufacturing nodes (5-14nm, 28nm). It emphasizes innovation to break foreign technology monopolies, increase domestic substitution, and expand product lines. R&D investment is significant, exceeding 10% of revenue, with a growing team and multiple ongoing projects in high-end and 'bottleneck' products.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is generated primarily through direct sales of electronic chemical products including electroplating solutions, photoresists, and auxiliary materials. The company employs a direct sales model with turnkey solutions that combine product sales with application process optimization and technical support. Sales are recognized upon delivery and customer acceptance.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: The company competes with international giants such as DuPont, Dow Chemical, JSR, and Merck in the semiconductor chemical materials market. Domestically, it is a leading supplier with over 20% market share in integrated circuit packaging electroplating chemicals and ranks among the top two in the domestic market. It is recognized as a national-level specialized and innovative 'little giant' enterprise.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2024, the company achieved operating revenue of approximately RMB 432 million, a 20% increase year-over-year, and net profit attributable to shareholders of RMB 33.5 million, a 2.5% increase. R&D expenses grew by over 40%, accounting for 10.6% of revenue. The company has total assets of about RMB 1.24 billion and net assets close to RMB 974 million, showing steady growth and expanding scale.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: The company emphasizes its strong independent R&D capabilities, proprietary core technologies, and comprehensive product portfolio covering the full semiconductor material chain from packaging to wafer manufacturing and display. It offers customized turnkey solutions integrating chemical products with process optimization and on-site technical support, enhancing customer production efficiency and product quality. Its products meet or exceed international standards, supporting domestic semiconductor industry self-reliance and import substitution.
